newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Mark, dlr, Sfr share modest Hungary FX futures trade.
newsitem.headline: Mark, dlr, Sfr share modest Hungary FX futures trade.

text.p: Trade was shared between mark, dollar and Swiss franc contracts on a low-key Budapest Commodity Exchange forex futures market which saw a modest 2.8 billion forints' worth of trade, dealers said.
All three currencies rose in line with spot rates, with the dollar up by between 30 and 50 fillers for all months, the most popular maturity being June, which rose 30 fillers to 185.1 forints.

The mark was mixed, falling for September but rising 10 fillers for the more popular March contract to 120.1 forints while almost all trade in the Swiss franc was for December, which rose 45 fillers to 137.65.
The yen was the day's loser, falling 50 fillers for September to 155 per 100 yen and 30 fillers for December to 161.6.

Central bank spot rates for the four currencies were fixed at midday at 104.79 forints for the the mark, up 0.02, 180.51 for the dollar, up 0.25, 123.00 for the Swiss franc, up 0.20 and 142.75 forints per 100 yen, down 0.25.
The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) forex futures market was tradeless.
